objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions, or other controlled content that goes through creation, editing, review, approval, and distribution processes.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: A short code assigned to the document based on its type.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current state of the document in its lifecycle such as Editing, Released, or Out of Force.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: The date from which the document version becomes valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: The date after which the document version is no longer valid.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The actual text and information contained within the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or Master data that the document references.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT systems or applications relevant to or referenced by the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies for which the document applies.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Geographic or organizational areas where the document is applicable.

attributes.name: electronic_signature
attributes.description: Digital signature applied by authorized participants during the approval process.

attributes.name: audit_trail
attributes.description: Complete record of all changes and actions performed on the document.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document that is automatically released with the main document and subject to the same release process, with its own versioning and archive status.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current state matching the main document status.

attributes.name: archive_status
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the attachment has been archived.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Supplementary material attached to a document that is not subject to the main document's release cycle and can be directly published or deleted.

attributes.name: published_status
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the additional information is published.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposed amendment to an existing document that can be managed separately without affecting the document version or content.

attributes.name: implementation_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the change proposal is scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: completion_status
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the change proposal has been completed.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to check whether a document should remain valid, be revised, or be invalidated.

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current status of the validity extension request.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to declare a document as out of force and archive it.

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current status of the override request.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document.

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person who interacts with the system in various roles such as Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Reader, or Translator.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The system role assigned to the user such as Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Reader, or Translator.

attributes.name: user_group
attributes.description: The group to which the user belongs.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned specific permissions and roles for document management and distribution.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: The name of the user group.

attributes.name: permissions
attributes.description: The access rights assigned to the group.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of users and user groups assigned to receive a document for information or acknowledgement.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution such as by email or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A confirmation by a user that they have received and reviewed a document.

attributes.name: confirmation_status
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed.

attributes.name: confirmation_date
attributes.description: The date when the acknowledgement was confirmed.

objs.name: template
objs.description: A predefined document structure that can be selected when creating new documents and may include automated metadata insertion.

attributes.name: template_format
attributes.description: The office format of the template such as Word, Excel, or PowerPoint.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: An assigned action in the approval or validation process workflow.

attributes.name: task_type
attributes.description: The type of workflow task such as Creation, Review, or Release.

attributes.name: assigned_to
attributes.description: The user or role to whom the task is assigned.

attributes.name: task_status
attributes.description: Current status of the workflow task.

attributes.name: days_since_last_change
attributes.description: Number of days since the task status was last updated.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: A division or department of the company that can be associated with documents or users.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A potential issue or concern that can be referenced or linked to documents.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Reference information in the system that documents can be linked to such as organizational units or IT applications.
